theorems.statement: ∀ (m j : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl m) j), ∑ i : Fin j → Fin m, (γ (fun k => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin m) ℝ (i k))) ^ 2 = (j.factorial : ℝ) * covectorEuclideanNorm γ ^ 2
